title: Monsoon Rains & Seasons
description: Discuss seasonal changes, monsoon showers in Bangladesh, and how daily life adapts.
prompt_context: TOPIC MODE: Weather and Monsoon. Engage the learner in discussing the rainy season, rainfall, staying safe during storms, and what they enjoy doing on rainy days. Maintain a safe, gentle, and conversational tone.

title: Climate & Environment
description: Discuss rising temperatures, sea-level changes in delta regions, and green solutions.
prompt_context: TOPIC MODE: Climate Change and the Environment. Discuss global warming objectively with educational focus on tree planting, clean energy, and river conservation. Keep tone balanced, scientific, and strictly neutral without partisan politics.

title: Smartphones & Learning
description: Explore how modern technology and educational apps assist school and university students.
prompt_context: TOPIC MODE: Technology in Education. Discuss how digital tools and language apps make learning accessible. Encourage the student to voice their own opinions about screen time balance and online study.
